description:
You are a Probation Officer conducting a quarterly caseload closure audit. The Complaints module in ArkCase contains 6 active probation cases. Three of these cases have expired supervision terms: their 'Supervision End Date' (shown in the case details) is before January 1, 2026. Three cases are still active with future supervision end dates.

For each case with an expired supervision term, take the following two actions:
1. Change the case Status to 'Closed'
2. Add a case note containing exactly: 'CASE CLOSED: Supervision term completed. Final compliance verified. Case administratively closed per SOP-PO-12.'

Do not modify the three cases with supervision end dates in 2026 or later.

Login: arkcase-admin@dev.arkcase.com / ArkCase1234!

metadata.required_note_text: CASE CLOSED: Supervision term completed. Final compliance verified. Case administratively closed per SOP-PO-12.
